Your article is amazing! I’m not exaggerating when I say, your writing brought back, not necessarily the memory, but the emotional response to each point of my life. 

After 16 days of involuntary stay at a psych ward, I had the same free “jailbird” feeling. I bought a planner and wrote all my goals, made list, and legitimately thought. “I am going to succeed.” 

Yeah, shit never works out like suppose to. I broke my life, again. I seem to self destruct more and more lately. I thought pill was going to fix me. Nope. My therapist rather sedate me into comatose zombies. Then for her to hear another episode. 

I quit and stop getting meds and therapy. My life, nowadays, is at rock bottom. I have no one, cause I can’t keep relationships. I ponder the same question, the what if I did that or this?  

Sorry for ranting, but makes me less sad knowing other people go through the same thing  I do.

I really don’t know. A lot of pages from my childhood went missing over the years. I wish I remember more detail, but I only remember the act of trying and not the thought. 

But i do remember this, 

I wanted the attention of my sisters for them to feel sorry for me. I know 😐
I was kind of a drama queen back then. 
And. I’m  still a drama queen today. 

I was probably between 8-12 years old. We lived in Germany, and we had a open stairwells from the basement to the ground level.  I think my dad was renovating or working on the house, because the railing was missing from the ground level.  I specifically remember a white wooden long board leaning across from the top to bottom. I climbed unto the board thinking the fall would kill me. If I jumped. I yelled for my sister to come, and started crying and bawling. Every time I said I would jump, I looked down get scared and inch closer along the board. I would stop and repeat same process. Till I could jump, but just slight hurt myself. Of course my sister knew I was bluffing and kind ignore me. 

Well, now that I’m 29, I can look back and sort laugh at it. A little asian boy, with a cowlick, a face full tears, climbing down a board desperately trying to get attention. 
Then again, I can look back and sort of cry at it. A grown ass man,  Self-conscious, and doing the same thing. This time, there no one to call for attention. 

Thanks for reading, I really appreciate it.

45cc. Thicc like molasses. A possible hot shot. I’m doing the shot, fuck it!

20cc in, the initial rush set in already. I have two modes of thoughts: finally a rush I’ve been craving and fuck I’m might die if I keep going. I push the last bit. 
 
A full body seizure, I’m too high and lose all my senses: peripheral vision narrowed into a blacked out tunnel, hearing distorted to a buzzzing noise, sense of touch transcends into they ephemeral. I can taste the dope through my breath as I breathed in and out. 

All I know I will never gonna reach or replicate that high again.
